title: I - Frames: composition, palette, character placement and contrast of the canonical Paper K-pop film

method.sampling: 3 frames per shot (start+0.2 s, middle, end-0.2 s; pad shrinks to 0.05 s on shots <0.4 s), decoded at 1920x1080 and analysed at 480x270 (reference crops at 480x480).
method.palette: k-means (k=14, seeded) in CIELAB, clusters merged at dE<9, roles assigned from HSV; top 8 reported.
method.field: largest 8-connected component of one palette colour; bars = palette components touching a frame edge, spanning >=85% of height, 3-45% of width, saturated, with a hard inner edge.
method.subject: character bbox annotated per shot from 10%-gridded contact sheets (3 frames/shot inspected); 49/54 shots have a character, 5 are prop/void beats. Boxes are accurate to about +/-3% of frame height; the automated face-anchor detector was used as a second opinion and rejected where it ran to the floor.
method.contrast: luma (Rec.709 on sRGB) and saturation-weighted circular hue; 'local' contrast compares the non-dominant pixels inside the subject box with the dominant colour inside the box (what the figure actually sits on), which is the only fair measure when the figure stands inside a colour bar.
method.edges: Sobel threshold 40; outline = dark runs (V<0.32, L<95) crossing the silhouette at 5 scanlines, scaled to 1080p.
method.uncertainty: character height +/-3 pts (annotation); centroid +/-0.01; palette shares +/-2 pts (8-bit video + quantisation); contrast +/-6 luma; bars +/-1 pt; shadow not reliably measurable at 480x270.
method.subjectBoxOrder: [x0, y0, x1, y1] as fractions of the frame

shotBoundaries.note: STORYBOARD.md timings used. ffmpeg at scene>0.3 returns 45 detections: 41 storyboard boundaries + 4 extras (95.03 flash, 110.67, 133.80, 155.93 fade). Frame differencing confirms 50 of 53 storyboard boundaries are hard cuts (mean |frame diff| > 12/255); 9 were missed by ffmpeg (8.95, 22.50, 29.72, 41.36, 52.80, 60.52, 73.80, 115.08, 117.02), 2 are soft (7.90, 135.40) and 1 is a melt (27.90).

invariants.rule: a drawn cast member is present
field reaches the frame edges (no plate/bars)
invariants.band: side bar <=8% of width; 0 in >=90% of shots
invariants.measured: 0 left bars, 1 right band in 54 shots (shot 45 lighting falloff)

invariants.rule: no blue figure on a blue field
invariants.measured: 1/49 trips in one frame (shot 34, its last frame)
p10 5.6 px; median 12 where hair/ink is crossed

invariants.band: optional; if present, hard, <=2% of frame height

paletteRolesMean.note: mean share of each role over the 49 character shots (roles below 1% folded into the nearest role by hue)

fieldRoles.note: largest flat field colour per shot; every shot has a different hex

uber.method: columns whose pixels are >60% cobalt (hue 200-250, s>0.45) or red (hue<15/>=345, s>0.5) over the full height, on the 10 collage frames (640x360)

canonical.note: shot 45 is split 56/44 by a lighting falloff, not a designed bar; no shot uses an edge bar as a layout device
